div.div: 2 زَنّأ عَلَيْهِ , inf. n. تَزْنِئَةٌ, He straitened, or oppressed, him; made strait, or close, to him; (S, K, TA;) as also عليه ↓ زَنَأَ . (TA.) The verb occurs without ء, written زَنَّى, by poetic license, in a saying of a rájiz cited in art. شدخ, as an ex. of the word شَادِخَةٌ. (S.) And عَلَيْهِ الحِجَارَةَ ↓ زَنَؤُوا occurs in a trad. as meaning They made the stones strait, or close, to him, or upon him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
